about: Hosea is a prophet who shows how God keeps loving His people, even when they run away from Him.

pages.title: Love That Never Quits
pages.scene: A father teaching a toddler to walk
pages.text: God's people kept running away from Him. But God said, "When Israel was a child, I loved him. I taught him to walk. I held him in my arms." God told Hosea to keep loving his wife even when she left, to show that God never stops loving us.

pages.title: Come Back
pages.scene: Flowers and a big tree growing strong
pages.text: Hosea said, "Come back to the Lord! Tell Him you're sorry." God promised, "I will heal them and love them freely. They will grow like flowers and strong trees."
pages.lesson: God welcomes us back when we say sorry.
